title: Release v5.0.0 — fyr serve, fyr work and the work skill, fyr check rule (d) (2026-10-31-0152)
body:
# Release v5.0.0 (2026-10-31)

## Type
release

## Summary
v5.0.0 ships `fyr serve` (ADR-075, ADR-075a, ADR-075b), `fyr work` (ADR-076, ADR-077, ADR-080) and the `work` skill, plus `fyr check` rule (d). It is a MAJOR by the operator's choice ("v5.0.0", 2026-10-31). The version rule found nothing an existing place must react to, so `fyr update` is the whole step.

Gate: `Preflight — v5.0.0`, SHIP over v4.1.0..bdabf69. The tag sits on this release commit. Its parent is the gated head bdabf69, and its diff from it is `.agents/trail.jsonl` only.

## Agents dispatched
- **reviewer:** code and docs over v4.1.0..5b716dd, APPROVE WITH NITS; round 2 over the fixes, APPROVE WITH NITS.
- **security:** over v4.1.0..5b716dd, FINDINGS (1 high cleared by ADR-075b with the operator's acceptance, 3 medium, 3 low). Two reads of the test files (part A: 3 low; part B: 1 medium, 4 low). Round 2 over the fixes: 1 high (the acceptance asked for and given), 2 low.
- **verifier:** at 6affb08, FAIL on § 3h only (8 spec-stale from the fix commit). The re-run at bdabf69 is PASS.
- **`fyr eval` on Antigravity**, run by the main agent on the operator's word ("You run them here (Recommended)"): `TEST-2026-10-31-0143-eval-10-of-10-pass-at-bdabf69`.
- **The main agent:** the real-home smoke on dave, 3 of 3 PASS; one real docker worker, 1 of 1 PASS.

## Gate fixes in the range
- 6affb08: BUG-200, BUG-201, BUG-202 and ADR-075b (`CHANGE-2026-10-31-0120-…`).
- bdabf69, records only: eight specs re-read against 6affb08.

The release commit also updates `SPEC-fyr-delivery` § Where things stand to name v5.0.0.

## Release notes
fyr v5.0.0 is a MAJOR release by the operator's choice (2026-10-31). The version rule found nothing an existing place must react to: `fyr update` is the whole step.

### New features
- **`fyr serve`, a local control page** (ADR-075, ADR-075a, ADR-075b): `fyr serve` shows the context, metrics, evals, logs, memory and records on `127.0.0.1` behind a per-run token. Its maintenance actions are `index` and `metrics ingest`. It runs in the foreground, started and stopped by hand.
- **`fyr work`, unattended agy workers from Kickoff files** (ADR-076, ADR-077, ADR-080):
  - Each Kickoff runs as an `agy -p` session on a clone of the checkout, with no remote, on the branch `work/<name>`.
  - The branch is fetched back and checked against the Kickoff's `Files:` line, and the result contract is printed.
  - Several Kickoffs run at once up to `--max-workers`, and `--kill <stamp>` stops a run.
  - `--runner docker` runs the session in a hardened container, built from `docker/work.Dockerfile`.
  - A model can be set per worker.
  - The worker gets the lead's time zone as its `TZ`.
- **The `work` skill**: a lead session plans waves of workers, squash-merges each PASS, and writes the Kickoffs for the next wave.
- **`fyr check` rule (d)**: the R → M → T traces between `PRD.md`, `SDD.md` and `TDD.md`.

### Improvements and optimisation
- **Lead-input hardening** for `fyr work` (workers D138–D140): a worker may add only handoff and change records, dated within its window in the lead's zone. Draft names are bounded, and the worker's Never line holds.
- **`internal/sandbox`**, extracted from `internal/eval`: `fyr eval`'s behaviour is unchanged.
- **The release gate's fixes**: a worker's symlink or submodule is refused whatever its `Files:` says, and test rigs no longer reach the machine's docker daemon or git config.

### Fixes
- A test's wrong token in `internal/serve` always differed from the real one (BUG-196).
- The `merge=union` line duplicated trail records when two parallel workers' records sorted around one existing line (BUG-197).
- `fyr work`'s scope check let a worker's symlink or gitlink through to the lead's squash (BUG-200).
- Two kill tests reached the machine's real docker daemon (BUG-201).
- The docs promised that a `fyr work` worker's data reaches only the model (BUG-202).

### Other updates
- **Skills**: `feature`, `handoff`, `review`, `testing-strategy`, `cloud-run-deploy` and `harness-audit` updated, and `work` added.
- **Rules**: `session-sizing` updated.
- **`PRD.md`**: R6 amended (ADR-078), the macOS known limits of `fyr work --runner docker` (ADR-079), and `PRD.md:114` struck as answered (ADR-081).

### Known limits
- A `fyr work` worker's agent runs with `command(*)` and the network. Only `--runner docker` keeps it off your files (all but its login token), and nothing keeps it off the network.
- The `work` skill's step 7.3 runs a worker's tests on the host.
- `--runner docker` on macOS is not yet run (workers Phase 7d).
- `fyr check`'s requirements rule and the requirements half of its trace rule check nothing on this repository until `PRD.md` takes the Must/Should shape.

### Install
- Download: see README § Install without cloning.
- Existing places: `fyr update`.
- `fyr work --runner docker` needs its image built from the `# Build:` line in `docker/work.Dockerfile` after every update that changes the binary.
- The behavioural runs for this release: `fyr eval` 10 of 10 PASS at bdabf69; the real-home smoke on dave 3 of 3 PASS; one real `--runner docker` worker 1 of 1 PASS.

# Change — eval metrics Phase 1: the estimators and the trial unit (migration 4, `--outcome error`, A6 per trial)   (2026-10-31-0746)

## Type
feature (Phase 1 of `PLAN-2026-10-31-0300-plan-eval-metrics-the-standard-set-collected-fro`)

## Summary
The metrics store gains the trial as the unit every rate reads: migration 4 adds the `trials` table and `sessions.run`, `metrics.RecordTrial` stores a trial once, `Options.Run` stamps a trial's sessions at insert, `--outcome` takes `error`, and A6 (`pass_k`) is computed per trial with Chen 2021's pass@k, τ-bench's pass^k, the Wilson 95 % interval and `flip`, its first keys unchanged. The report's pass^k chart draws the interval. No verb or flag is removed; `fyr eval` does not yet write trials (Phase 2a), so every existing command line behaves as before and a store at schema 3 migrates forward on its next open.

## What changed
- **`internal/metrics/estimators.go`** (new) — `PassAtK`, `PassPowK`, `Wilson`, `OutcomeConsistency`, `SeqSimilarity`, stdlib arithmetic (R4); `estimators_test.go` pins the plan's known answers (n=4, c=3 → pass@2 = 1, pass^2 = 0.5; Wilson (5,5) = (0.5655, 1), (3,0) = (0, 0.5615), (6,6) = (0.6097, 1); `SeqSimilarity(["Read","Bash"], ["Read","Edit"])` = 0.5) and more, each recomputed independently in Python (`math.comb`) before being written.
- **`internal/metrics/store.go`** — `migrations[3]`: `CREATE TABLE trials(run PRIMARY KEY, label, row_version, kind, cluster, expect, harness, cli, status, cause, started_at, seconds, session_seconds)` and `ALTER TABLE sessions ADD COLUMN run`; `tables` gains `trials` so `export` writes it.
- **`internal/metrics/trials.go`** (new) — `Trial`, `Store.RecordTrial` (`INSERT OR IGNORE`; refuses a status outside pass|fail|error, a cause missing on fail/error or present on pass or not identifier-shaped, no run or harness, a label not `KEY=VALUE`, text not printable or over 120 bytes, a negative count, a zero start time), `trialsIn` (the window's trials under `--label` or `--all-labels`; none in the default view or under `--project`), `trialRuns` (every run in the store, the claim set).
- **`internal/metrics/ingest.go`, `writer.go`, `agy.go`, `agy_conversation.go`** — `Options.Run` (Go-only), written on each session at insert with `run = COALESCE(sessions.run, excluded.run)`, never by a label-wide UPDATE; `validateRun` (a Run needs `Source`, printable, ≤ 120 bytes) in `Validate` and at the top of `Ingest`; `--outcome error` accepted and stamped like pass and fail.
- **`internal/metrics/show.go`, `show_types.go`, `show_finish.go`, `show_write.go`** — the sessions query selects `run`; `passK(all, trials, claimed)` counts a `trials` row once (pass/fail graded, error apart) and a main session with an outcome that no trial in the store claims as one trial of its own; `PassK.estimate` fills `n`, `c`, `errors`, `pass_at` and `pass_pow` for k in 1, 3, 5 up to n (omitted above), `wilson95` and `flip`, rates at four decimals; the text line gains the new fields.
- **`internal/metrics/report.go`** — `passKChart` reads c of n with the Wilson whisker (`passKRow`), errors and flip in the value text, nine table columns; `.whisker` CSS.
- **`cmd/fyr/help_text.go`, `cmd/fyr/ctx_verbs.go`** — `--outcome pass|fail|error`.
- **Tests** — `trials_test.go` (migration 4 from a schema-3 fixture and the schema-5 refusal, `RecordTrial` once and its refusals, `Options.Run` kept over a second ingest and refused without a source, `--outcome error`), `show_test.go` (`TestShowPassKTrials`: seven labels covering a trial with two sessions, an error trial, a NULL-run session, six trials, errors only, all failed, a session whose trial was never written, the window, the default view, `--project`, `--label`; `TestShowLabels` extended), `report_test.go` (`TestPassKChartDrawing`, the whisker and columns in the self-contained report), `store_test.go` (export of `trials`), `cmd/fyr/metrics_arms_test.go` (`TestMetricsIngestOutcomeError`).
- **Records** — `SPEC-fyr-metrics` (the `--outcome` row and `Options.Run`, the `show --json` example and the `pass_k` keys, § Report, A6's definition, § Data's SQL and the trial paragraph, § Invariants, three failure-mode rows, four verification rows); `SPEC-fyr-eval` § Known limits (D12 closed for trials recorded with a run; `fyr eval` writes them from Phase 2a). `README.md` names no outcome value, so it needed no edit (the plan's box named it).

## Agents dispatched
- `documentation`, once, over the two spec drafts with the diff and `fyr search --refs` output for every changed path: it tightened the refusal list in three places of `SPEC-fyr-metrics` and confirmed README, SDD and TDD need nothing.
- An adversarial pre-review workflow (`wf_115e3739-ace`, 24 agents: four lenses — the estimators' numbers, the store and queries, consumers and restatements, test validity — then two refuters per finding): 16 findings, 12 distinct, 3 confirmed and fixed, 7 refuted (its `## Outcome` in the review record below); its reads were confined to the tree and `.agents/scratch/wf-phase1/`.
- `reviewer`, once, `--code --docs` over the working tree: `REVIEW-2026-10-31-0727-review-worktree-code-docs-eval-metrics-phase-1-2` (APPROVE WITH NITS; three findings, all fixed, each with a test that fails without it; round 2 skipped under the review skill's Step 4 rule).

# Change — PLAN.md P2: `fyr check` rule (b) bisects the trail's history, 5m26s → 1.5 s of CPU   (2026-10-31)

Plan: root `PLAN.md`, P2 (its three boxes ticked; D8, items 41 and 42 added). Base: `2da906b`.

## What changed

- **The hot path, named with numbers.**
  - A CPU profile of `check.Run` over this checkout (`.agents/scratch/p2-check-speed/pprof-top10.txt`) gave 270 ms of Go CPU in a 510 s run, 0.05%.
  - A `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` run of the pre-fix binary gave 10 `git log -G` calls for 565.3 s of git time. Every other git call together took under 0.1 s.
  - Each `-G` diffs all 399 revisions of the 13 MB `.agents/trail.jsonl`, once per current spec: about 55–60 s each.
- **`internal/check/trailhistory.go` (new).** Rule (b) now finds each spec's commit this way:
  - It bisects HEAD's first-parent commits that changed `trail.jsonl` (`rev-list --first-parent HEAD -- .agents/trail.jsonl`). Each blob is read once with `git cat-file blob` and indexed for every spec, in one pass per line.
  - When the commit found is a merge whose merged side holds the line, it searches that side's own first-parent chain, recursively, to a depth of 64.
  - A commit that deleted the trail holds no line.
  - The reads and the count run with `--no-replace-objects`, `core.commitGraph=false` and `GIT_GRAFT_FILE=/dev/null`.
  - A blob over 256 MiB is refused from its `ls-tree -l` size, and the read is capped with `io.LimitReader`.
  - `trail.Readable` is checked before the first read.
- **`internal/check/specs.go`.**
  - `specCommit` (`git log -G`) is removed, along with the `regexp` import.
  - `specsRule` uses the history reader.
  - The count runs through its git options.
  - The note for a failed history read is now `<ID>: trail history unreadable: spec not checked` (was `git log failed`).
- **Tests** (`trailhistory_test.go`, `trailhistory_guard_test.go`, `trailhistory_index_test.go`; `hardening_test.go` comments and the note text):
  - `TestSpecCommitBisects` pins the work count: 40 trail commits and 3 specs, at most 19 blob reads, and each commit found is the one that added the line.
  - `TestSpecRuleMergedLine`, `TestSpecRuleNestedMerge`, `TestSpecRuleMergeAddsTheLine` and `TestSpecRuleDeletedTrail`.
  - `TestSpecRuleBlobOverCap`, `TestSpecRuleIgnoresReplaceRefs`, `TestSpecRuleCountIgnoresReplaceRefs` and `TestSpecRuleMergeDepth`.
  - `TestIndexMatchesTheRegex`, against the regular expression `-G` compiled, over 10 edge lines and 5000 generated ones; `TestIndexIsLinearOnALongLine`.
- **Restatements.**
  - `internal/serve/pages.go:46`: the comment no longer says a check "takes minutes".
  - The `SPEC-fyr-check` record: rule (b)'s commit, cost and bound, the note text, and two Known limits (a line removed and re-added; a NUL-byte revision now matched).
  - The `SPEC-fyr-serve`, `GUIDE-testing` and `GUIDE-fyr-matrix` records: "3–4 minutes" becomes about 1.5 s since 2026-10-31.
- **Re-stamped after a re-read** (item 41), with status current and the body unchanged:
  - `SPEC-fyr-work`, stale since P1's `c89b966`, whose `notInRuleA` change it does not describe. `SPEC-fyr-serve` was stale for the same reason and its body edit (above) re-stamped it.
  - `SPEC-fyr-dream`, `-eval`, `-memory-loop`, `-metrics`, `-record` and `-search`, which name `internal/serve`, whose only change here is the comment.
- **`PLAN.md`.**
  - The P2 boxes are ticked and the status line updated.
  - D8 records the hot path, the fix, what changes in meaning, the equality evidence and the rejected options.
  - Item 41: the stale specs. Item 42: `leadGit` lacks `core.commitGraph=false`, fixed in P4.
  - The Risks line is updated.

## Agents dispatched

- `reviewer`, two rounds:
  - `REVIEW-2026-10-31-1057-review-p2-code-and-docs-round-1-2026-10-31`: REQUEST CHANGES, 4 medium and 2 low. All fixed; see its `## Outcome`.
  - `REVIEW-2026-10-31-1057-review-p2-code-and-docs-round-2-2026-10-31`: REQUEST CHANGES. The quadratic index (fixed in round 3), the boxes, and the unreachable `visited` (removed).

  - `REVIEW-2026-10-31-1057-security-review-p2-trail-history-bisection-round-2`: 1 medium, 2 low. All fixed. The `leadGit` part becomes item 42.

- **`internal/harness/repo.go`.**

  - `Behind`'s fetch error names the remote (`remoteForDisplay`: no userinfo, query or fragment, and nothing for a URL that does not parse) and the checkout (`ShellArg`), with the port-443 hint, then quotes git.
  - `ShellArg` single-quotes, or uses `$'…'` for a control character.

# Change — PLAN.md P4: fyr work's lead reflog guard, the docker worker's limits and run network, the commit-graph off in the lead (2026-10-31)

Phase: `PLAN.md` P4 (items 12, 13, 42), under the `bug` skill for item 12 (BUG-198). ADR-083 amends ADR-079 and answers D109. D13 records how the items were read.

## What changed

- **Item 12, BUG-198** (`internal/work/reflog.go` new, `fetch.go`, `preflight.go`):
  - The newest reflog entry of the lead's HEAD and of the branch it points to is recorded with the base.
  - Step 6 fails every worker `lead checkout changed` when either entry is no longer the newest. The note names the ref, how many entries the run added, and the first of them.
  - New refusal 23: a checkout with either reflog empty is refused before anything is made.
  - The branch's reflog came from P4's security review (finding 3): a move made from another worktree writes only the branch's reflog.
- **Item 42** (`fetch.go`): `leadGit` adds `-c core.commitGraph=false`.
- **Item 13** (`internal/sandbox/docker.go`, `internal/work/docker.go`, `work.go`, `worker.go`, `slots.go`):
  - Limits: each container runs with `--memory 8g --memory-swap 8g --cpus 2 --pids-limit 1024`, down from `--pids-limit 4096` alone.
  - New refusal 24: a daemon whose `docker info` cannot apply a limit is refused (security finding 1).
  - Run network: one per run, `fyr-work-<stamp>`, a bridge labelled `fyr.work=<stamp>` with `enable_icc=false`. It is made after the refusals and before the stamp line. If it cannot be made, the run is refused and never put on the default bridge. `dockerArgs` refuses any network that is not a run's own.
  - Sweeps: the run's sweep, and `--kill` of a stale stamp, remove the network after the containers. `--kill` of a stamp with no pid file removes only that stamp's networks, and nothing while the stamp's pid is alive (security findings 4 and round 2). A run refused for its pid file sweeps its network first.
- **Docs, in the same commit:**
  - `SPEC-fyr-work`: refusals 23 and 24, step 6, Docker mode's limits and network, the sweep, failure modes, open questions, Verification.
  - ADR-083.
  - `TDD.md` § T17 and § T18.
  - `GUIDE-testing` § 3k and `GUIDE-fyr-matrix` § `work`.
  - BUG-198 is fixed. BUG-204 is new and open.
  - `PLAN.md`: P4's boxes ticked, D13, and items 45 and 46 (both P12b).

## Tests

- New tests:
  - `TestRunLeadReflogMoved`, `TestRunLeadNoReflog`, `TestReflogMoved`, `TestReflogBranchMovedFromWorktree`, `TestLeadGitHistoryOptions`;
  - `TestRunNetworkLeftIsNamed`, `TestRunPidFileFailSweepsNetwork`.
- Extended tests:
  - `TestDockerArgs` and `TestDockerArgsRefuses`: the limits, one network, and the networks refused.
  - `TestRunDockerPass` and `TestRunDockerRefusals`: network-fail, no-swap-limit and no-limits.
  - `TestKillStaleSweeps` and `TestSweepContinues`.
  - `cmd/fyr`'s fake docker answers `docker info`.
- The item 12 and 42 tests failed before the fix. Mutations: 15, then 6, then 3 after the review rounds; all 24 red.
- The full test command passed before the reviews (exit 0). The verifier's run on the frozen tree: `TEST-2026-10-31-1255-verification-plan-md-p4-the-lead-reflog-guard-an`, PASS, 1761 pass, 0 fail, 6 skip; the `eval --list` of HEAD's and the tree's fyr identical.

## Exercised on dave (2026-10-31)

- **Real docker worker:**
  - Command: `fyr work --home ~/sandbox/fyr-work/home --repo <this checkout> --runner docker --image fyr-work:p4`, on the fixture.
  - Setup: the image was built from the tree's build `6f3109cda8f7+dirty`; docker 29.7.2, agy 1.4.12.
  - Result: 1 of 1 PASS in 238s, agy exit 0, 2 commits.
  - `docker inspect` of the live container: 8 GiB memory and swap, 2 CPUs, 1024 pids, and only the run's network, whose inspect showed `enable_icc=false`.
  - The worker committed its `/sys/fs/cgroup`: `pids.max 1024`, `memory.max 8589934592`, `memory.swap.max 0`, `cpu.max 200000 100000`.
  - The worker reported its `go test -race ./...` passing. A host rerun in the same image under the same limits exited 0.
  - Afterwards `docker network ls --filter label=fyr.work` listed nothing, and no container was left.
- **Connection checks** (`.agents/scratch/p4/icc-smoke.txt`), from a second container to a listener container:
  - on an `enable_icc=true` bridge: replied;
  - on an `enable_icc=false` bridge: timed out;
  - from one `enable_icc=false` bridge to another: timed out.
- **`docker info`** printed `true true true true`.

## Not checked

- A daemon with `"iptables": false` (the network made, `enable_icc` not enforced).
- A large module's `go test -race` under the limits.
- A real `git gc` expiring the recorded reflog entry mid-run.
- `sweptNote`'s non-nil branch.
- The Mac.

## Reviews

- Round 1:
  - `REVIEW-2026-10-31-1242-review-plan-md-p4-code-and-docs-round-1-2026-10` (approve with 3 low nits);
  - `REVIEW-2026-10-31-1242-security-review-plan-md-p4-docker-limits-run-net` (4 low).
- Round 2:
  - `REVIEW-2026-10-31-1246-review-plan-md-p4-round-2-over-the-fixes-2026-10` (approve with 3 low nits);
  - `REVIEW-2026-10-31-1246-security-review-plan-md-p4-round-2-over-the-fixe` (1 new low).
- Every finding was fixed, or stated with evidence. Round 2's findings were fixed past the cap, as in P2 and P3. Each Outcome names its test or mutation.
- Round 2's `security` agent rewrote this checkout's `.git/HEAD` during a probe (BUG-204). The main thread restored it before any commit; `PLAN.md` item 46 graduates the rule.

## Agents dispatched

`reviewer` ×2, `security` ×2, `verifier` ×1.

title: Release v5.5.0 — eval metrics, the UI skills, records-only reads
body:
# Release v5.5.0 — eval metrics, the UI skills, records-only reads, a release gate that held (2026-11-01)

## Type

feature

## Summary

fyr v5.5.0 is a MINOR: `fyr update` is the whole step. A project still on files runs `fyr record import` first.

## New features
- **`fyr eval --runs N`** and the trial record: per-trial and per-row tables, Wilson intervals (eval metrics Phases 1, 2a, 2b).
- **`fyr metrics evals`**, the report's per-row table, and an evals page in `fyr serve`.
- **The eval suite's `version`, `kind`, `cluster` and `expect` columns**, with per-kind rates (ADR-085).
- **`frontend-ui-economist` and `frontend-ui-modern`** replace `frontend`.
- **The `agy-dispatch` rule**: read the quota and choose by tier before `fyr work` or `fyr eval`.

## Improvements and optimisation
- `fyr check` runs in about 1.5 s, from over 5 minutes of CPU.
- `--runner docker`: resource limits and one network per run (ADR-083), and host git on what a session wrote runs under a memory limit, a deadline and an output bound.
- `PRD.md` moves to the Must/Should shape; `TDD.md` § T5 thinned to spec links.
- The file-era trail goes: search and the dream read records only (ADR-086, ADR-087); `fyr record import` is the one migration path.

## Fixes
- A development build at a zip place could not move: `status` and `update` work there (ADR-082, BUG-203).
- `fyr work` refuses a run during which the lead's HEAD reflog moved (BUG-198).
- The clone's `.git` is checked before the host's `upload-pack` reads it, and mounts at, under or above the sandbox fail it.
- Check e and the credential scan fail closed; the scan's read is bounded.
- `fyr update`'s error names the remote without credentials or query; `ShellArg` holds under dash; a search panic on a long reference.
- BUG-206: the macOS test build and two date tests.

## Other updates
- **Skills**: `bash`, `docker`, `golang`, `harness-audit`, `retro`, `review`, `review-standards`, `typescript` and `work` updated. **Agents**: `reviewer` and `security` gain the git-probe rule (BUG-204).
- **`PRD.md`**: R3 says no tool granted (ADR-089), R0's date (ADR-088).

## Known gaps
- `fyr work --runner docker` has not been run on macOS: if `ulimit -v` is refused there, each worker ends at `no commits`.
- Whether agy refuses a plan-mode write outside `brain/` is not shown (ADR-089).

## Install
Download: see README § Install without cloning. Existing binary-only places: `fyr update`; a place on v2.7.0 or earlier: `DEPLOY-remote` § Crossing to fyr (v3.0.0 only).

Gate: `Preflight — v5.5.0`, range v5.0.0..dcedd46.
