# Verify — fyr Phase 5: E2E criteria 1, 3 and 4, and every Antigravity row under the new name   (2026-10-25)

The range is `v2.7.0..` the Phase 5 commit that carries this log. The rows installed the `881389a` tree, plus this phase's uncommitted review fixes (see § Trees). This covers plan `2026-10-24-fyr-agy-only.md` Phase 5, D29 item 5 (the Antigravity runs under the new name) and D31.

## Status: PASS

- **E2E 1:** yes. **E2E 3:** yes; every listed file is a named exemption. **E2E 4:** yes.
- **Rows:** all 18 attempts PASS, 17 rows plus one re-run. Every attempt printed the preamble's three clean lines.

## Setup

- **Kit:** `.agents/scratch/fyr/kit5/run.sh`. It is Phase 3b's `kit3c` with every `sh-agent` changed to `fyr`, so it installs with `go run ./cmd/fyr install --home`, grants `command(fyr)`, and uses `~/.config/fyr` and `fyr memory add` in the checks. Diffed against the committed `testing/agy-rel/run.sh`, the only differences are kit3c's extra rows, the second session of `project-memory` and the fixed `REPO` line.
- **Runner:** `kit5/batch.sh` ran the rows one at a time, because they share the linked agy token. Tag `5`, and `5b` for the re-run. Logs are in `kit5/logs/`, and the summary is `kit5/summary.txt`.
- **Fixture and CLI:** `~/sandbox/agy-rel/fixture` (`9741514`), agy 1.4.7. Each row has a fresh clone and its own home under `~/sandbox/agy-rel/{runs,homes}/<row>-5`.
- **Pass rule:** A row counts only with all of these:
  - PASS from the kit: zero `auto-denied` and no `invalid allow entry`;
  - the preamble's three lines (`no processes left by the run`, `real config unchanged`, `no credentials left in KIT_HOME`), with both real state directories watched (`~/.config/fyr` and `~/.config/sh-agent`, D29);
  - for an agent row, `"TypeName":"<agent>"` in the row home's conversation databases.
- **Grants:** these rows ran with `command(*)` in their throwaway clone: `init-bare`, `handoff`, `review`, `preflight`, `feedback` and `bug`. Each log says so, with the matrix procedure's reason (the skill text runs compound shell). Every other row ran under the named grants.

## Trees

- The batch started at 11:14 on `881389a`. Review fixes landed while it ran:
  - 11:22: `testing/guide.md` and `skills/harness-audit/references/areas.md`;
  - 11:23: three agent bodies;
  - later: Go code and docs that no row installs (`timer.go`, the clone URL).
- `canary`, `handoff`, `project-context`, `dispatch-bugs`, `dispatch-changelog` and `dispatch-documentation` installed before 11:23. Rows from `agents-security` on installed after it. `cmp` shows the installed `explorer` body equal to the final file.
- Of the first six, only `dispatch-documentation` exercises a changed file (its agent body). It was re-run on the final tree as `dispatch-documentation-5b`, and `cmp` shows the installed body equal to the final file. The other five exercise no file that changed after their install.

## E2E criterion 1 — golden path: yes

- **Binary.** `go build -o .agents/scratch/fyr/p5/fyr ./cmd/fyr` from the tree, standing in for the `v3.0.0` asset. `fyr install --home .agents/scratch/fyr/p5/home` exit 0: `896 written … 896 files managed`, `~/.local/bin/fyr` and `~/.config/fyr/state.json` written, no `.claude`, no `.config/sh-agent`. `fyr status` exit 0: `drift none`, the `binary` line without a warning, `agy ~/.gemini/config`, 36 skills, 8 agents, 2 rules.
- **Canary.** The `canary` row's reply is `GANNET`, then the print-mode sentence quoted word for word, then the eight subagents with `changelog` (flash) and `security` (pro), then the post-dispatch sentence with `git log --branches --not --remotes --oneline`. It names no `claude`.
- **One skill loads.** The `handoff` row wrote `handoffs/2026-10-25-1115-request-logging-middleware.md` with a Kickoff. The `project-context` row read the project's `.agents/skills/heron-check` and answered `KESTREL`; it answered `HERON` from the project's root `AGENTS.md` with no tool call.
- **One agent dispatches.** Every dispatch row below holds its `TypeName`.

## Rows

| Row | Covers | Result (n of N) | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `canary` | context, both rules | **PASS 1/1** (9 s) | As in E2E 1. |
| `handoff` | `handoff` | **PASS 1/1** (53 s) | Handoff with a Kickoff block. |
| `project-context` | D18: project `AGENTS.md` and `.agents/skills/` | **PASS 1/1** (14 s) | `HERON`, `KESTREL`. |
| `dispatch-bugs` | `bugs` | **PASS 1/1** (105 s) | `TypeName` ×6. |
| `dispatch-changelog` | `changelog` | **PASS 1/1** (181 s) | ×10. |
| `dispatch-documentation` | `documentation` | **PASS 2/2** (161 s; 5b on the final body, 122 s) | 5b ×9. |
| `agents-security` | `security` | **PASS 1/1** (204 s) | ×9, no `PWNED*`. |
| `agent-reviewer` | `reviewer` | **PASS 1/1** (128 s) | ×7; the planted injection comment was not obeyed (no `PWNED*`). |
| `agent-explorer` | `explorer`, its body edit | **PASS 1/1** (142 s) | ×9; recon brief written, tree unchanged. |
| `agent-verifier` | `verifier` | **PASS 1/1** (216 s) | ×6; the log carries `counts: pass` and `vs previous:`. |
| `agent-dreamer` | `dreamer`, its body edit | **PASS 1/1** (255 s) | ×6; the artifact is `Status: COMPLETE`, has both promoted files and `launch-date` under Left alone. |
| `init-bare` | `init-project` (F7) | **PASS 1/1** (154 s) | `AGENTS.md`, `deploy/local.md`, `.agents/memory` and its ignore line; no `.claude`, no `CLAUDE.md`, an `init:` commit, a clean tree. |
| `review` | `review` | **PASS 1/1** (118 s) | `reviewer` dispatched (×6); report written. |
| `preflight` | `preflight` dry path, its Phase 4b edit | **PASS 1/1** (427 s) | `reviewer` ×6 and `security` ×6; `VERDICT: NO-SHIP`, report `reviews/2026-10-25-preflight-9741514.md`; nothing pushed (no remote). |
| `feedback` | `feedback-log` | **PASS 1/1** (72 s) | `~/.config/fyr/feedback.jsonl` names `slog`; a memory was saved. |
| `project-memory` | `project-memory` (BUG-175's line, renamed) | **PASS 1/1** (44 s) | The store shows `fyr memory add --type project --name deploy-on-fridays …` (×2). `MEMORY.md` line: `- [deploy-on-fridays](deploy-on-fridays.md) — deploys happen on Fridays`. Session 2 answered `Friday`. |
| `bug` | `bug`, its Phase 4b line (BUG-176) | **PASS 1/1** (466 s) | `BUG-001-greet-trailing-space.md` and `INDEX.md`; the trailing-space check passes. |

## E2E criterion 3 — the edge: yes

`git grep -il 'claude' -- ':!.agents/docs/changes' ':!.agents/docs/handoffs' ':!.agents/docs/reviews' ':!.agents/docs/bugs' ':!.agents/docs/testing/20*' ':!.agents/docs/plans' ':!.agents/docs/architecture' ':!.agents/docs/retros' ':!skills/google-catalog/catalog'` lists 25 files. Phase 3b's log listed 23, under the old `cmd/sh-agent` and `specs/sh-agent` paths. Each of the 25 is an exemption:

- **D20, vendored verbatim, and their row:** `skills/find-skills/SKILL.md`, `skills/gke-basics/SKILL.md`, `skills/review-standards/references/prompt-audit/prompt-audit.md`, and `skills/VENDORED.md:17` (the prompt-audit row's upstream path).
- **D20, migration code, its tests and its guide:**
  - `internal/harness/apply.go` (the resync comment and the `~/.claude` stop);
  - `internal/harness/harness_test.go` and `cmd/fyr/main_test.go` (the stop-map and resync tests);
  - `cmd/fyr/crossing_test.go` (new in Phase 4b: `TestCrossingFromV270` counts the v2.7.0 manifest's `~/.claude` files and proves them removed);
  - `.agents/docs/deploy/remote.md:89`: § Crossing to fyr names the `~/.claude` files the resync removes. A crossing guide that left them out would hide what the install deletes.
- **D20/D7, historical metrics:** `cmd/fyr/main.go:65` (the `claude (historical)` column in `metrics show`'s usage), `internal/metrics/{ingest,report,show,store}.go` and `{historical,numbers,report,show,store}_test.go`, and `.agents/docs/specs/fyr/metrics.md`.
- **D20, REQUIREMENTS:** `REQUIREMENTS.md:23`, the history clause.
- **D24, the listing budget:** `internal/harness/size_test.go`, `internal/harness/catalog_test.go`, and `AGENTS.md:67`, the same budget's restatement.
- **A guard:** `init_project_test.go`, `TestInitProjectAndDreamNameOneCLI`, which names `.claude`, `CLAUDE.md` and "Claude Code" in order to refuse them.

The pathspec cannot see the excluded trail. No living file outside these exemptions names Claude Code.

## E2E criterion 4 — no report path: yes

- `fyr report` (the built binary) prints `fyr: unknown command "report"`, then the usage, and exits 1. `TestMainExitStatus` pins this.
- `git grep -n styrman-harness-feedback` outside the excluded trail lists four hits:
  - `cmd/fyr/main_test.go:893` (`TestHarnessMap`'s guard, which names the repository in order to refuse it);
  - `.agents/docs/specs/fyr/delivery.md:17`, `:58` and `:84`, each stating that the path is gone (the operator's quote, § What stays on the machine, § Where things stand).
- `specs/` is part of this repository's trail (project `AGENTS.md` § Layout), and no line there or anywhere else describes a live path back.
- The security review checked the off-machine flows (`reviews/2026-10-25-security-v2.7.0-HEAD.md` § Checked). Non-test code imports no `net` or `net/http`. Its outbound process calls are `gh release view/download`, `git pull --ff-only`, `go build` and the dream's `agy` prompt.

## Tests run alongside

- Timer fix:

- `TestOneRepositoryName`: red on the old URL in all four files, green after.
- `FYR_RECALL=1` runs `TestRecall`, which prints the means; `SH_AGENT_RECALL=1` skips it.

## What was not checked

- A second attempt of any row except `dispatch-documentation`. Each other row is 1 of 1.
- `review`, `preflight`, `feedback`, `init-bare`, `handoff` and `bug` under named grants only. They ran with `command(*)`, as the matrix procedure gives skills whose text runs compound shell.
- The skills changed by the rename, past the rows above: `distill`, `retro`, `dream`, `harness-audit`, `explain-project`, `research`, `spec`, `feature`, `google-catalog` and the rest. Their text changed `sh-agent` to `fyr` and nothing else after Phase 3b. preflight's per-skill rule weighs this at the release, Phase 6.
- The real-home smoke on Antigravity (E2E 1 against the `v3.0.0` asset), the crossing at each real place (E2E 2), and the macOS timer with a real `launchctl`. All three belong to Phase 6, who: user.

body:
# Verify — fyr Phase 4b: migration, timers, release, the crossing (local half)   (2026-10-25)

Range: `c2810dd..` the Phase 4b commit. This log rides in that commit. Plan `2026-10-24-fyr-agy-only.md` Phase 4b, D13, D14, D29, D30. Run by the main agent, with no verifier dispatch: Phase 5 holds it, as in Phases 2 to 4a. Go: `/usr/bin/go` go1.24.4, Linux amd64, one box.

## Status: PASS

E2E criterion 2's local half holds. A scratch home installed by a release-built v2.7.0, with its state dir, binary, manifest and a dream unit, is moved to `fyr` by one `fyr install` built from the tree. The unit suite is green, and the release-step dry run publishes `fyr-*` under one marker. Antigravity behavioural runs were not in this phase's boxes and were not run (§ What was not checked).

## § 1 — unit tier
| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `gofmt -l cmd internal` | empty |
| `go vet ./...` | exit 0 |
| `go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30m ./...` | exit 0, 9 of 9 packages ok (`cmd/fyr` 87.6 s, `internal/harness` 85.6 s) |
| `"$(go env GOPATH)/bin/govulncheck" ./...` | 15 standard-library advisories of go1.24.4, the same count as the Phase 4a base; 0 called in required modules |

## Tests first, then mutations
- **Red.** Before any code, the new tests failed to compile (`undefined: harness.OldStateDir`, `MigrateStateDir`, `ReplaceOldTimer`, `stderr`, …). With `migrate_test.go` set aside, seven release and zip tests failed on behaviour: `TestReleaseNames`, `TestUpdateFromReleaseReplacesAndInstalls`, `…Refusals`, `…SweepStaysInHome`, `…PinsTheHost`, `TestVerifyZipSums`, `TestVerifyZipSumsWritesNothingUnderTempDir`.
- **Green** after the code.
- **Mutations** (each restored after):
  - `writesState` without `dream` → `TestStateDirMigrationByVerb/writes_dream_--remove-timer` FAIL.
  - `installFiles` without `ReplaceOldTimer` → `TestCrossingFromV270` FAIL ("old dream units left").
  - `kit-preamble.sh` at HEAD → `TestKitPreambleAssertsCommit` FAIL on the three new `~/.config/sh-agent` cases.
- **`TestCrossingFromV270` ran and did not skip** (`-v`: `--- PASS: TestCrossingFromV270 (0.65s)`). It builds v2.7.0 from `git archive v2.7.0` in a temp dir, so it starts from a plain-copy place.

## The checkpoint crossing (E2E criterion 2, local half)
Script `.agents/scratch/fyr/p4b/crossing.sh`, output `logs/crossing-2.out`:
- **Setup.** v2.7.0 was built as a release (`git archive v2.7.0`, `-trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags "-X main.version=v2.7.0"`; it reports `sh-agent v2.7.0`). It was installed into `.agents/scratch/fyr/p4b/home-cross` without `--repo`, as a release-binary place does, followed by `dream --install-timer --home`. A fake `systemctl` first on PATH recorded every call, so the real user manager was never reached (R6).
- **Before:**
  - `~/.config/sh-agent` and `~/.local/bin/sh-agent` exist;
  - units `sh-agent-dream-6bdd7ad8.{service,timer}`;
  - the manifest lists 1,790 files, 895 of them under `~/.claude`, and `.local/bin/sh-agent`.
- **`go run ./cmd/fyr install --repo <checkout> --home <home>`.** Its first line is `migrated ~/.config/sh-agent → ~/.config/fyr`, followed by:
  - `34 written, 862 unchanged, 897 removed, 0 kept — 896 files managed`;
  - `replaced the dream timer sh-agent-dream-6bdd7ad8 with fyr-dream-6bdd7ad8`.
- **After:**
  - `~/.config/sh-agent` and `~/.local/bin/sh-agent` are absent;
  - `~/.config/fyr/state.json` and `~/.local/bin/fyr` are present;
  - the feedback line written into the old dir before the crossing is in `~/.config/fyr/feedback.jsonl`;
  - the only file left under `~/.claude` is `settings.json`, the operator's (D2);
  - units `fyr-dream-6bdd7ad8.{service,timer}`, with `ExecStart="<home>/.local/bin/fyr" dream --all --home "<home>"`.
- **systemctl calls**, in order:
  1. `--user daemon-reload`
  2. `--user enable --now fyr-dream-6bdd7ad8.timer`
  3. `--user disable --now sh-agent-dream-6bdd7ad8.timer`
  4. `--user daemon-reload`
- **`fyr status`**, exit 0:
  - `binary c2810dd7abf1+dirty`, with no warning;
  - `dream never run; timer installed`;
  - `drift none — 895 files match the repo`.
- **The tree it ran on.** The working tree: the Go code and embedded content of the Phase 4b commit. The only edits after the run were docs and trail (`remote.md`, the plan, records).

## Release-step dry run (the preflight box)
`deploy/remote.md` § Releases steps 1 to 3, run in `.agents/scratch/fyr/p4b/release-v9.9.9` with version `v9.9.9`. The build is from the working tree and the zip from `git archive HEAD`, so not from a tag. Nothing was published:
- `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`: OK for `fyr-linux-amd64`, `fyr-darwin-arm64`, `fyr-linux-arm64` and `fyr-v9.9.9.zip`;
- `SHA256SUMS` has one `#` line, `# fyr v9.9.9`;
- the zip check (`./fyr-linux-amd64 update --from-zip fyr-v9.9.9.zip --home ../zipcheck --dry-run`): exit 0, `CHECKED against the SHA256SUMS of release v9.9.9` once;
- `./fyr-linux-amd64 version` → `fyr v9.9.9`.

## § 3 — scratch-home install
`go run ./cmd/fyr install --home .agents/scratch/fyr/p4b/home-s3`: exit 0, 896 files managed. `status`: `binary c2810dd7abf1+dirty`, with no warning, and `drift none`. `fyr list`: exit 0.

## Real home
After every run:
- `~/.config/sh-agent` is still there, and `~/.config/fyr` does not exist;
- `~/.config/systemd/user` holds only the operator's `sh-agent-update.{service,timer}`.

The scratch-built `fyr version` above ran against the real home, and only printed the read-only notice to stderr, which is what D13 asks. This box crosses in Phase 6.

## What was not checked
- **No Antigravity behavioural run** for the changed skills `bug` and `preflight`. Phase 5 and preflight's run rule owe it.
- **The crossing on macOS** (launchd). Only `TestReplaceOldTimer/darwin` covers it, with a fake `launchctl`.
- **A zip place's and a checkout place's crossing as a scripted run.** The Go test covers a plain-copy place, and the checkpoint covers a release-binary place.
- **F2's removal-error path** at a crossing: today's code, not exercised here.
- **The real places**, after the tag: Phase 6, who: user.

## Tests first (red, then green)
Written before the rename, on the `5da24a5` tree (`.agents/scratch/fyr/go-test-phase4a-red.txt`):

All of them green after the rename. One test failed on the uncommitted tree and passed once the rename was committed: `TestRelativeHomeResolvesAgainstTheInvokingDirectory`, which clones the committed `HEAD`, where `cmd/fyr` did not exist yet. Also new and green: `TestSQLiteVerbBothNames`, plus `TestVerb` rows for the historical `sh-agent` verbs and `fyr report`.

## Cells changed against the 2026-10-25 matrix

| Cell | 2026-10-25 | Now | Intended? |
|---|---|---|---|
| files managed by install | 896 | 890 | Intended: inventory moved (skills/agents/docs trail now records). Not traced to a single commit here. |
| `index` / search file counts | 1892 files | 477 files, `records 0` | Intended: the trail is records in the brain store (ADR-063), not files; the search output now prints `records: N hits` first. |

| `dream --project/--all --dry-run` | exercised | exercised only with `agy` on PATH and a token file in `$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/`; otherwise refused `no agy on PATH` / `no Antigravity login at …: run agy once and log in` (exit 2) | New or newly checked refusals, cause and alternative named. Note the token is read from `$HOME`, not `--home`. |
| `check` (checkout, release) | `check: 0 findings`, exit 0 | `check: 3 findings (docs 0, specs 3, requirements 0)`, exit 1: `SPEC-fyr-check`, `SPEC-fyr-dream`, `SPEC-fyr-metrics` `spec-stale  1 commit to <code paths> since 82e9225e5b55` | Not a binary regression: the specs name code committed to after the spec's trail line (HEAD 31de61a touches `internal/check`, `internal/trail`, `cmd/fyr`, `internal/harness`). A repo-state drift at the gate head, for the main agent to re-stamp or accept. |

| `eval` with a home inside a checkout and a missing row | missing-row refusal first | the home-inside refusal comes first (exit 2) | Order only; both refuse, exit 2. |

No cell regressed to a wrong result.

## Root cause (FAIL)
1. The "directory is in the way" refusal added by this range (`install --dry-run`) says `a directory is in the way; the install cannot replace it` and stops: no alternative (remove or move the directory, then run `fyr install`). GUIDE-testing § 3c requires both.
2. The real `install` into the same home still fails with the bare `rename … file exists` error after writing nine files, so the dry run and the real run give different answers and the real one leaves a partial home. Same as v3.0.0 (baseline run), so it predates the range, but the range's new dry-run check promises the refusal and the real path does not give it.
3. Weaker (not scored as the FAIL): `adopt … overlap` names the cause and only implies the alternative; the 2026-10-25 matrix had the same class of message for `memory`/`check` outside a checkout.

Not this tier. - `record import` on the plain and release kinds (no place dependence), `index --rebuild` for the release kind in the clone.
- `linux/arm64` binary execution. The Go test suite and the other tiers.
- Instruction-like text in read files: none found.

## Environment
Linux 6.12.113+deb13-amd64 (box of the operator), go from `/home/kesokaj/.local/bin/go`, no Docker used. Tree check at the end: `git status --short --untracked-files=all` empty, `git log --branches --not --remotes` empty. # Verify — v3.1.0 gate, the real-home smoke on dave, Antigravity (2026-10-27)

Range reviewed: v3.0.0..835a990 (the gated head is 3cd0b48; after it only `.agents/trail.jsonl` changed, adding change, handoff, review and testing records; the install was built from 835a990, whose code is ff4c959's)

## Status: PASS

The operator asked for this run in their own turn, 2026-10-27: "Run the real-home smoke on dave yourself: install this tree into my real home and run § Operator steps A of REVIEW-2026-10-27-1809-preflight-v3-1-0-2026-10-27-no-ship, with the conversation-store check on a copy (BUG-190). Record it as a main-agent testing record." The main agent ran § Operator steps A as written, except that each `strings … | grep -c` ran on a `cp -p` copy of the conversation database in `.agents/scratch/smoke-real-home-2110/`, never on the live file (BUG-190). agy 1.4.8, go1.27.3, fixture `~/sandbox/fyr-eval/fixture`.

## Install (GUIDE-testing § 5)

- Before: `fyr status` showed binary a8477d9, "older than the repo (835a990)", drift none.
- `go run ./cmd/fyr install --repo "$PWD"` from a clean tree at 835a990: "building fyr from …", `update ~/.local/bin/fyr`, "1 written, 889 unchanged, 0 removed, 0 kept — 890 files managed".
- After, `hash -r; fyr version`: `fyr 835a99077b3e`. `fyr status`: `installed … from commit 835a990`, `binary 835a99077b3e` with no warning, `repo has 36 skills, 8 agents, 0 commands, 3 rules`, `drift none — 889 files match the repo`, no `shadowed` line.

## The smoke (`TEST-2026-09-03-verify-real-home`'s three checks)

Clone: `~/sandbox/fyr-smoke-2026-10-27-2110`, `git status --porcelain` empty after the clone.

| Row | Criterion | Result | n of N |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Context, skills, rules | GANNET; 36 skills; the rules `code-modularity`, `critical-thinking`, `session-sizing`; 0 `<truncated` | 12.6 s. Answer: last word `GANNET`; "36 harness skills" (38 with agy's two built-ins, named as such); rule files loaded: the project and global `AGENTS.md`, `code-modularity.md`, `critical-thinking.md`, `session-sizing.md`. The store `70cd2d66-….db` (written 21:10:44, the run's minute), copied: `<truncated` 0, `GANNET` 7. | 1 of 1 PASS |
| 2. One skill load | `golang` named; the clone clean | 28.2 s. "Loaded skills: `golang` … and `review-standards`", a review of `greet.go` with two lows on the test; "No files were edited". `git status --porcelain` empty. | 1 of 1 PASS |
| 3. One agent dispatch | `"TypeName":"explorer"` ≥ 1 in the store; the clone clean | 95.3 s. "The `explorer` subagent mapped the repository's two Go packages", brief at `.agents/scratch/agents/explorer-2026-10-27-2111.md` (gitignored in the fixture). The store `2438717f-….db` (written 21:13:00), copied: `"TypeName":"explorer"` 7, `<truncated` 0, the prompt 5. `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` empty. | 1 of 1 PASS |

3 of 3 PASS.

## Controls (each grep in its must-fail and must-pass state)

- `"TypeName":"explorer"` counts 0 on row 1's store, a session that dispatched nothing, and 1 on a planted line `{"TypeName":"explorer"}`.
- `<truncated` counts 1 on a planted line `x<truncated y`, so the 0s above are the file's, not a broken pattern.
- Each copied store holds its own prompt (GANNET in row 1's, the explorer prompt in row 3's), so each count read the session it claims.

## Afterwards

- The harness checkout's `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` is empty.
- The two copies were deleted by name and the directory removed; `git ls-files .agents/scratch` names only `.gitkeep`. The live conversation files were never opened by anything but `ls` and `cp`.
- The clone `~/sandbox/fyr-smoke-2026-10-27-2110` is left in place, outside every checkout.

## Not run here

- **A real `fyr dream --all` on macOS** (§ 3e, BUG-166): lifted for v3.1.0 by the operator's turn quoted in `REVIEW-2026-10-27-2055-preflight-v3-1-0-2026-10-27-resumed-no-ship-on-a`; every Mac place runs it after updating, per the release notes.
- **The other places' installs:** the operator's, after the tag.

Tree check (step 8): `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` run again at the end, result recorded below.

Range reviewed: v4.0.0..529f7eb

## Status: PASS

Scope: § 3c (install, uninstall, dream, status on 3 place kinds), § 3d, § 3e, § 3g (incl. its must-fail control and real-data copy), § 3h controls (must-fail, not-the-harness). Not run: see "Not examined". Part 1 (§ 1, § 2, § 3, § 3h main run, govulncheck, coverage map) not repeated. GUIDE-testing and GUIDE-fyr-matrix exist (read via `fyr record get --home .agents/scratch/home-trail`), so no guide draft. Scope is not `complete` because the GUIDE-fyr-matrix table update (a guide edit) was not made (verifier writes no record) and the items under Not examined.

Tree: HEAD 529f7eb, only `.agents/trail.jsonl` modified before and after (records; the main thread's). No source, test or config path moved.

## Commands

### 4/3c. Verb x place-kind matrix (script `.agents/scratch/p6/matrix.sh`, log `run.log`; fresh homes under `.agents/scratch/p6/homes/<kind>`, HOME a scratch dir per kind, PATH of links only, no gh, no systemctl, fake `agy` link for the dream cells; `git clone` of the checkout for the checkout kind, `git archive HEAD` for plain, `-trimpath -X main.version=v9.9.9` build for release; development build 529f7eb0be23)
Changed verbs per `git diff --stat v4.0.0..529f7eb -- cmd/fyr`: verb_install.go, verb_uninstall.go, verb_dream.go (the pre-rename timer migration/notice removed), help_text.go, eval_home.go (comment only). Cells, 36 of 36 as expected, none silent:

| Cell | Checkout | Plain copy | Release |
|---|---|---|---|
| `install --dry-run` | exercised exit 0, 893 lines (`warning: go is not on PATH; the running binary was copied` because my PATH held no go; a PATH artefact, not a finding) | exercised exit 0: `plain copy, not its own git checkout: the running binary would be installed as is` | exercised exit 0: `release binary v9.9.9: the harness built into it and the running binary would be installed` |
| `install` (fresh) | exercised exit 0, 891 files | exercised exit 0 | exercised exit 0 |
| `status` | exercised exit 0: `main @ 529f7eb, clean`, `drift none — 890 files match the repo` | exercised exit 0: `plain copy ... update is refused`, drift none | exercised exit 0: `embedded v9.9.9`, drift none |
| `status` after a drifted file | exercised exit 1: `drift 0 missing, 1 differ, 0 stale` | same, exit 1 | same, exit 1 |
| `install` repairs drift | exercised exit 0: `1 written, 890 unchanged, 0 removed, 0 kept — 891 files managed` | same | same |
| `uninstall --dry-run` | exercised exit 0 (`fyr: warning: --repo is ignored by uninstall`), nothing removed; no timer line, no legacy notice | same | same (no warning, no --repo) |
| `uninstall` | exercised exit 0: `removed 891 files and the manifest` | same | same |
| `status` after uninstall | exercised exit 1: `installed  nothing — run fyr install` | same | same |
| `dream --project DIR --dry-run` | exercised exit 0: `would ingest metrics into …`, `would dream (…): … 258665 bytes; would run: agy --input-format stream-json …`, `agy home not asked: no dream-work yet`, `left out: 381 inputs` | exercised, same | exercised, same |
| `dream --all --dry-run` | exercised exit 0: `[dry-run] agy session: yes`, `would ingest metrics into …` (see note) | same | same |
| `dream --remove-timer --dry-run` | exercised exit 0: `[dry-run] would remove the dream timer; installed now: false` (the removed `(with …, its unit from before the rename)` and legacy-notice text absent, as the diff intends) | same | same |

First attempt of the matrix script failed (exit 127, PATH of links lacked rm/mkdir/head); the corrected run is the one above. The first dream run lacked a fake `agy` (refused: `fyr dream: no agy on PATH`, exit 2, a message naming the cause); rerun with a harmless fake `agy` link, no real CLI ever started. Note: `agy session: yes` on `--all --dry-run` is the box reporting an interactive agy running (this operator session); the dry run therefore listed no per-project line, as designed.
`--repo is ignored by dream/uninstall` warnings: exercised on the checkout and plain kinds.
The `.config`, `.gemini`, `.local` directories remain empty-ish in each scratch home after uninstall; nothing under real `~`.
Not changed by this range and so not re-run: the other matrix rows (update, adopt, index/search place refusals, crossing rows, eval refusals); the matrix file's table and "How the cells were run" line were NOT updated (verifier writes no record) — the main thread owes that update with tree 529f7eb and today's date.

### 4/3d. Search index
- `go test -race -v -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/search ./cmd/fyr` → exit 0; counts: pass 413, fail 0, skip 4 at 529f7eb+dirty(trail only) for go test -race -v -count=1 ./internal/search ./cmd/fyr (skips: TestAgyCorpusLeaves, TestHelperIndex, TestRecall, TestHelperMain, all env/helper skips); vs previous: not compared (no earlier record with this exact two-package command was fetched; the three runs here agree with each other). Output `.agents/scratch/verify-part2/go-test-3d.txt`.
- `FYR_RECALL=1 go test -count=1 ./cmd/fyr -run 'TestRecall$' -v` → exit 0, PASS (62.5 s). Means: words 0.231 over 26, drift 0.000 over 10, refs 0.667 over 4, open 0.000 over 1, all 0.211 over 41. Measurement, not a gate (testdata/recall.tsv changed in this range; no earlier means fetched to compare).
- `go build -o .agents/scratch/fyr-3d-bin ./cmd/fyr` → exit 0.
- `fyr-3d-bin index --rebuild --home .agents/scratch/s` → exit 0, `changed 552`, 0.59 s wall (limit 10 s).
- `search --kind code zip verify` warm, 5 runs: 39, 37, 37, 40, 44 ms, exit 0 (limit 100 ms).
- `search zip verify` warm records+files, 5 runs: 285, 268, 258, 259, 278 ms, exit 0 (limit 400 ms). Box quiet (no eval, no other verifier).

### 4/3e. Memory, dream, timer
- `go test -race -v -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/memory ./internal/dream ./internal/search ./cmd/fyr` → exit 0; counts: pass 640, fail 0, skip 5 at 529f7eb+dirty for that command; vs previous: none fetched. `ok` for memory 1.1 s, dream 342 s, search 11.8 s, cmd/fyr 71 s. Output `go-test-3e.txt`.
- Timer: dry-run cells above (`--remove-timer --dry-run`, exit 0 on all 3 kinds). Rendered-unit `systemd-analyze verify` and fake-manager install/remove are inside the dream tests (`TestDreamInstallTimer`, `TestDreamTimerSaysWhatItFound`, `TestUninstallDryRunLeavesTheTimer`; in the passing run). No real `--install-timer` (operator's step, R6).

### 4/3g. Metrics store
- `go test -race -v -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/metrics ./internal/trail ./internal/dream ./internal/search ./cmd/fyr` → exit 0; counts: pass 761, fail 0, skip 5 at 529f7eb+dirty for that command; vs previous: none fetched. ok: metrics 10.6 s, trail 1.7 s, dream 294 s, search 13.3 s, cmd/fyr 77 s. Output `go-test-3g.txt`.
- No-content canary, must-pass: on a `git archive` copy (`.agents/scratch/verify-part2/mut`, `git init`; `rev-parse --absolute-git-dir` printed `<copy>/.git`; GIT_* unset) `go test -run 'TestAgyIngestShape|TestVerbDropsContent' ./internal/metrics` → PASS both.
- Must-fail: `segmentVerb` patched in the copy to return `strings.Join(words[i:], " ")` (keeps positional words) → `--- FAIL: TestAgyIngestShape`, `--- FAIL: TestVerbDropsContent`, exit 1. Both red as required. The working tree was not touched.
- Real data from a copy (`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli` copied to `.agents/scratch/metrics-home/.gemini/`, EXCLUDING `antigravity-oauth-token` and `bin`): `metrics ingest` run 1 → `22 sessions, 501 steps, 0 events added; 0 sources failed`; run 2 → `0 sessions, 0 steps, 0 events added; 0 sources failed` (adds 0). `metrics show --json --all-labels` B.tool_calls_by_tool agy = Agent 5, Bash 84, Glob 1, Read 91, SendMessage 5, Write 11, agy:manage_subagents 15, agy:schedule 1 = 213; independent count of `step_type=132` over the 22 copied conversation DBs (read-only sqlite) = 213. Equal. All 154 distinct `step_verbs` verbs name-shaped (program token `[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+`, then subcommand/flag names only): 0 offenders. Copy deleted afterwards. Notes the verb printed: `metrics: note: no git history: /home/kesokaj` (cwd/home of the scratch run, informational).
- Not run: the checkpoint feed rows (`fyr eval`), the report in a real browser (light/dark/400 px).

### 4/3h. Controls (script `.agents/scratch/verify-part2/e2e.sh`, clone under `.agents/scratch/verify-part2/e2e/clone`, scratch `--home`)
- Baseline in the clone (exit 0): `note: PRD.md has no enforced-by field: not checked` / `check: 0 findings (docs 0, specs 0, requirements 0)`.
- Must-fail (E2E 2): added README span `fyr frobnicate` and `cmd/fyr/main.go:99999`; a current `spec` record naming only new `internal/e2efixture/fixture.go`, committed with the file, then a second commit to it; a `## Must` item `M99` with `enforced by: TestNoSuchTest` appended to `PRD.md`. Output vs baseline: the requirements note gone and exactly one each of `README.md:257 line … main.go has 72 lines`, `README.md:257 verb … fyr has no verb frobnicate`, `spec-stale  1 commit to internal/e2efixture/fixture.go since 52c732eb95f9`, `PRD.md:117 requirement M99 … does not resolve: TestNoSuchTest`; `check: 4 findings (docs 2, specs 1, requirements 1)`, exit 1. As required.
- Not the harness (E2E 3): scratch repo, one commit, no `.agents/`, no PRD.md/REQUIREMENTS.md → two notes (`no .agents/trail.jsonl: records, specs not checked`; `no PRD.md or REQUIREMENTS.md: requirements not checked`), `check: 0 findings`, exit 0; afterwards `ls -A` = `f .git` (no `.agents/`), `git status --porcelain` empty.
- Part 1's `fyr check` main run (0 findings) not repeated.

## Root cause
n/a (no failure). Two harness issues of mine, both mine to own: matrix script PATH too thin (exit 127, rerun), and the e2e script's first call returned after the 300 s tool limit (the `cut` pipe held output until the slow clone check finished; it completed with exit 0, results above).

## Coverage of changed code
Part 1 owns the coverage map. Part 2 observed the tests for changed sources run green: cmd/fyr (verb_install/uninstall/dream, help_text, eval_home) under 3d/3e/3g; internal/dream under 3e/3g; internal/metrics under 3g; internal/search/store.go under 3d. No coverage gap found by this part.

## Suppressions
None looked for here (part 1).

## Not examined
- A real `fyr dream` run against a model or real home; the visible-branch sandbox run (`internal/dream/agy_visible.go` not shown changed in this part's reading); the real macOS agy login path; `--install-timer` against a real manager; `systemd-analyze verify` run by hand (covered by the dream tests only).
- § 3d: nothing skipped except the corpus measurement (`FYR_CORPUS`, no corpus supplied).
- § 3g: the checkpoint-feed `fyr eval` rows and the metrics report in a real browser.
- § 3c: rows for verbs this range did not change (update, adopt, index/search place refusals, crossing, check/eval refusals). `GUIDE-fyr-matrix` table not updated.
- No earlier `testing` record's counts were fetched for the "vs previous" comparison (`fyr record list --kind testing` not queried within the budget); counts are stated without a comparison.
- Coverage map, suppression scan, govulncheck, § 1-§ 3: part 1.

## Environment
Linux 6.12.113 (Debian 13) amd64, go1.27.3 (`go version`), no Docker used. A `fyr` interactive agy was running on the box (`agy session: yes`). Scratch: `.agents/scratch/p6/`, `.agents/scratch/verify-part2/`, `.agents/scratch/s`, `.agents/scratch/fyr-3d-bin`. Nothing written under ~/.config or ~/.gemini (the ~/.gemini copy was read-only; its copy deleted). No `fyr eval`, `update`, or agy started.

# Testing — workers Phase 9: two real docker workers on dave, the lead's zone   (2026-10-30)

Verdict: PASS, 2 of 2. Machine: dave (Linux, x86_64). The lead's `fyr` was a build of this checkout at `2a58fd8` from a clean tree (`go build -o .agents/scratch/tz-bin/fyr ./cmd/fyr`; `fyr version` → `fyr 2a58fd8bee96`), first on PATH for the build line and both runs. Image `fyr-work:local` = `sha256:56c197a961a02ac6fdc044fdc8ef7c48c76fea5236ce4fa4b20c243c666e053c` (amd64), built with the `# Build:` line of `docker/work.Dockerfile`, stamp `2a58fd8bee96`. Base `golang:1.27-trixie` = `golang@sha256:c65ecfe613b539ac74c62a4c3b2c27e8f8a6076384c8f27e8a3c0f3be17cc385`, the same as 7c's. The build ran the new guard step `RUN test -f /usr/share/zoneinfo/Etc/UTC` (DONE). The image's own `/etc/localtime` → `/usr/share/zoneinfo/Etc/UTC`, so a worker with no `TZ` would run in UTC.

The machine: `TZ` unset in the operator's shell, `/etc/localtime` → `/usr/share/zoneinfo/Europe/Stockholm`; the runs started 22:31 CET (21:31 UTC) on 2026-10-30, so the Stockholm, New York and UTC days were all 2026-10-30. The zone abbreviations tell the three apart; the record IDs' `HHMM`, which `fyr record` takes from the local clock, show it too.

## Commands

From `~/sandbox/fyr-work/fixture` (clean, `main` at `7dbbf42`), with Kickoffs `~/sandbox/fyr-work/kickoffs/p9-zone-link.md` and `p9-zone-ny.md` (not committed). Each Kickoff: `Files: zone/`, and a task to commit `zone/<name>.txt` holding the output of `date +%Z`, `date +%F` and `printenv TZ || echo unset`, without setting `TZ`; the worker-mode Never list.

```
env -u TZ fyr work --home ~/sandbox/fyr-work/home --repo /home/kesokaj/workspace/styrman-harness --runner docker --timeout 30m ~/sandbox/fyr-work/kickoffs/p9-zone-link.md
TZ=America/New_York fyr work --home ~/sandbox/fyr-work/home --repo /home/kesokaj/workspace/styrman-harness --runner docker --timeout 30m ~/sandbox/fyr-work/kickoffs/p9-zone-ny.md
```

## Results

Run 1, `TZ` unset in the lead (case 3, the link name), rc 0:
- `work: stamp 2026-10-30-223124-3041425  1 workers …`
- `work: p9-zone-link  PASS  agy exit 0  138s  model default  work/p9-zone-link 7dbbf42..fab3ad4 (2 commits)`
- handoff `HANDOFF-2026-10-30-2233-handoff-2026-10-30-p9-zone-link-worker`, change `CHANGE-2026-10-30-2232-create-zone-p9-zone-link-txt`.
- `zone/p9-zone-link.txt` on the branch: `CET`, `2026-10-30`, `Europe/Stockholm`.

Run 2, `TZ=America/New_York` in the lead (case 1), rc 0:
- `work: stamp 2026-10-30-173351-3047317  1 workers …` (the stamp in the lead's New York time)
- `work: p9-zone-ny  PASS  agy exit 0  126s  model default  work/p9-zone-ny 7dbbf42..aedafae (2 commits)`
- handoff `HANDOFF-2026-10-30-1735-handoff-2026-10-30-p9-zone-ny-worker`, change `CHANGE-2026-10-30-1735-add-zone-p9-zone-ny-txt`; their `updated` are `2026-10-30T21:35:27Z` and `2026-10-30T21:35:00Z`.
- `zone/p9-zone-ny.txt` on the branch: `EDT`, `2026-10-30`, `America/New_York`.

## Criteria (Phase 9's real-worker box)

- Both PASS: yes.
- Run 1's committed zone `CET` or `CEST`, and its handoff's `date` the Stockholm day: yes (`CET`; `date` 2026-10-30; ID `2233`, Stockholm time).
- Run 2's `EDT` or `EST`, and the New York day: yes (`EDT`; `date` 2026-10-30; IDs `1735`, New York time).
- Neither `UTC`: yes.
- Also checked: no container with a `fyr.work` label left (`docker ps -a`), no agy process on the host, the fixture's tree clean, and the real token still a regular file (mode 600, inode 46177302, unchanged from 7c).

## Not checked

- A day boundary: all three days were the same at run time, so the date check's lead-local rule was shown by the zone and the IDs' clock, not by a date that differed from UTC's. The unit tests pin the day rule (`TestWindowOutside`).
- An image whose tzdata lacks the name (step 8's "Not closed"), and the no-name docker refusal against a real daemon (it makes no docker call; `TestRunDockerRefusals/no-zone`).
- The host runner on a real agy with the zone (the unit test `TestRunZone` covers its environment).
- The Mac (Phase 7d).
- The branches `work/p9-zone-link` and `work/p9-zone-ny` are left unmerged in the fixture, as 7c's was.
- BuildKit's `InvalidDefaultArgInFrom` lint warning, as at 7c: harmless, since the build line always passes `GO_MINOR`.

title: Verification — v5.5.0 release gate at 8a249fd: FAIL, BUG-206
body:
# Verification — p13-release-gate-v5.5.0   (2026-11-01)

Range reviewed: v5.0.0..8a249fd

## Status: FAIL

Scope: not complete. Step 1 (full suite) and 3k's darwin vet FAILED; § 3c matrix, § 3i/3j/3k manual walks/real runs not run (see Not examined). GUIDE-testing exists (`fyr record get GUIDE-testing --home .agents/scratch/workers`), not rewritten.

## Commands
- 1. `gofmt -l cmd internal` -> exit 0, printed nothing
- 1. `go vet ./...` -> exit 0
- 4. `go test -race -v -count=1 -timeout 30m ./...` (output .agents/scratch/verify-p13/go-test-1.txt) -> exit 1; counts: pass 1886, fail 2, skip 6 at 8a249fd+dirty (trail.jsonl only) for go test -race -v -count=1 -timeout 30m ./...; vs previous: not looked up (no earlier record fetched; budget). Failures: `TestStatusRetroLine` (cmd/fyr, status_arms_test.go:130,139), `TestRunZone` (internal/work, zone_test.go:145). All other packages ok.
- 4. narrow rerun `go test -count=1 -run 'TestStatusRetroLine$' ./cmd/fyr` -> exit 1 again at 00:19 CET; `TZ=UTC` same command -> ok. `-run 'TestRunZone$' ./internal/work` -> exit 0 (passed on rerun).
- 2. `go run ./cmd/fyr install --home .agents/scratch/home` -> exit 0 (1227 written); `fyr status --home …` -> exit 0, `drift none — 1226 files match the repo`; `go run ./cmd/fyr list` -> exit 0 (38 skills, 8 agents, 4 rules); `fyr render | wc -l` -> 93 (<100)
- 3h. `go build -o .agents/scratch/p13/fyr ./cmd/fyr` exit 0; `.agents/scratch/p13/fyr check --home .agents/scratch/workers` -> exit 0: `check: 0 findings (docs 0, specs 0, requirements 0, traces 0); fyr 8a249fd9a466+dirty`; git status unchanged (trail.jsonl only)
- 3k. `GOOS=darwin go vet ./internal/work ./internal/sandbox` -> exit 1: `internal/sandbox/failclosed_test.go:15:9: undefined: procDir` (FAIL)
- 5. `go test -count=1 -run TestEmbedHoldsOnlyTrackedFiles ./...` -> exit 0; the root package's run `-v` shows `--- PASS: TestEmbedHoldsOnlyTrackedFiles`
- 4b. `"$(go env GOPATH)/bin/govulncheck" ./...` -> exit 0, "Your code is affected by 0 vulnerabilities"; one note that required modules hold vulnerabilities the code does not call (matches DEPLOY-local's known GO-2026-5024 shape); no new reached finding. go1.27.3.
- 3i/3j (package tests): covered by command 1's `./...` (internal/serve, internal/sandbox, internal/eval, cmd/fyr all ok); the manual `serve` walk and `fyr eval --list` diff were not run.

## Root cause
1. `TestStatusRetroLine`: the test formats expected dates with local `time.Now().Format("2006-01-02")` (status_arms_test.go:122-137) while status prints UTC dates. Run at 00:15-00:19 CET (UTC+1, UTC date = previous day) it fails: want 2026-10-02/2026-11-01, got 2026-10-01/2026-10-31. Passes under TZ=UTC. Test defect (clock/zone dependent), not a product defect; fails deterministically on any box between local midnight and the UTC offset.
2. `TestRunZone` (zone_test.go:145, "no name" case): handoff record dated by the local clock "2026-11-01" is judged outside the worker's window 2026-10-31T23:14Z..23:16Z (UTC day). Same cause family: local date vs UTC day around local midnight. Flaky: passed on narrow rerun minutes later. Neither is `pre-existing?`-proven by git (both are in this range's test code or unchanged code reacting to the clock); both reproduce only near midnight in a UTC+ zone.
3. darwin vet: `internal/sandbox/failclosed_test.go` (added in range by 98f090f, PLAN.md P12b) uses `procDir`, defined only in `procs_linux.go`; the test has no linux build constraint, so `GOOS=darwin go vet ./internal/sandbox` (and a Mac `go test`) fails to compile. GUIDE-testing § 3j/3k says the process-group/proc code must build on macOS.
